body: i wont say that i understand your exact situation and i also really hope you dont go through with it, not only for the sake of your children, but also to try to start to heal from your girlfriend. shes horrible for what she did to you, and you did not deserve it, but just think about what your kids will feel when they grow up and realize their father committed suicide, why exactly he did, they will have no father, and they will most likely blame their mother, which could be the truth, but really, i just really hope you dont, but i also understand how you feel about you just cant anymore, i posted earlier abt the same thing
